question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Flatter
solution:
The correct answer is "**Insult.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Flatter means to praise or compliment excessively.**(चापलूसी)

 
 
• Example: He flatters himself that he speaks fluent German.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym of flatter is insult, which means to offend or disrespect someone.
 
 
• **Insult is the opposite of flatter as it involves speaking or behaving in a way that is disrespectful or critical.**(अपमान करना)
 
 
• Example: You Insulted me by talking in that tone.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Soil means to make dirty or stain something. (मिट्टी)
 
• Adulate means to praise or flatter someone excessively.(झूठी प्रशंसा करना)
 
• Cajole means to persuade someone through flattery or coaxing.(फुसलाना)
